caribbean.headline: Caribbean Conditions: St. Lucia
caribbean.paragraph: St. Lucia in the Lesser Antilles is the highest-impact location in the Caribbean this period, with winds peaking at 9 kt and seas building to 4.5 ft with E swell at 7s periods. 88% rain probability -- expect disrupted conditions for shore excursions and tender operations.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos in the Eastern Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 21 kt and seas building to 5.2 ft with NE swell at 6s periods. less than 10% rain probability -- overall conditions are favorable for cruise operations.
